notes.title: New Version Release v1.32
notes.content: [h3]We’ve greatly enhanced controls for both gamepads and VR controllers:[/h3][list][*][p]Actions that previously required multiple keys can now be executed with dedicated buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Body type changes that required multiple keys can now be performed with a single dedicated button.[/p][/*][*][p]Rotation can now be controlled with the stick.[/p][/*][*][p]Movement and rotation stick inputs now support full analog control.[/p][/*][/list][p]With analog stick movement and rotation, fine adjustments are now much easier![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Display & UI Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]When key bindings change (such as in Direct Menu or panel operations), the corresponding keys are now displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]The “Normalization Gauge” for Dark Succubi is now always visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the transparency of the Slime body, making it easier to see objects hidden behind it.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Behavior & Stability Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Upgraded the game engine version for improved stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced Succubus behavior control.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Other Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Updated the manual.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor adjustments and refinements.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]These improvements are also applied to the Demo version—enjoy![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667854/1d2567ff5a95939c812dfa85aa7fe82f3ebbc8a9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667854/9901336d08f3a3205cdf7a4414d001d816e70c04.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Version Release v1.22
notes.content: [p]We’ve fixed an issue where players could pass through solid walls and other fixed objects.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Other Improvements[/h3][p]Added new sound effects.[/p][hr][/hr][p]This fix is also applied to the Demo version—enjoy![/p]

notes.title: New Version Release v1.21
notes.content: [h3]You can now use the non-designated VR controller to simplify certain actions.[/h3][hr][/hr][p]The VR controller was originally designed so you can play entirely with just one hand—but with two controllers, the experience becomes even smoother and more comfortable.[/p][p]Rotation can now be controlled with the stick on the second controller.[/p][p]The trigger on the second controller is bound to the Select Key, allowing you to operate without shifting your fingers.[/p][p]You can choose which controller (left or right) to use as the main one in the Options menu.[/p][p]For those with strong VR legs, you can now soar through space with ultra-acrobatic moves by rotating while moving![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Other Improvements[/h3][p]Updated the manual.[/p][p]Minor adjustments and refinements.[/p][hr][/hr][p]These improvements are also available in the Demo version—enjoy![/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667854/907c0a0c1884c4fff9a012b68bf2a9512f0fc480.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Version Release v1.18
notes.content: [h3]When a gamepad is connected during Standard Play, you can control the game with both the keyboard & mouse and the gamepad simultaneously.[/h3][p]Since rotation can now be controlled with dedicated keys, you can perform more complex actions—such as rotating while moving. For those who want to enjoy it as an action game, this is a great new option![/p][p]And now… you can also play on gaming handheld PCs![/p][p]Take your harem anywhere you go![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Other Improvements[/h3][p]Updated the manual.[/p][p]Minor adjustments and refinements.[/p][hr][/hr][p]These improvements are also available in the Demo version—enjoy![/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667854/dcfaa45cbc1618c9f330bd197e7470dc47e59bca.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Version Release v1.12
notes.content: [h3]We’ve simplified the process of connecting the Slime to the Succubus.[/h3][h3]Now, by transforming into a Connection Body and making contact, the connection happens automatically.[/h3][olist][*][p]Press the Sub Key (Right Click), then hold the Main Key (Left Click) and press the Select Key (Space) to transform the Slime into the Connection Body.[/p][/*][*][p]In this form, simply touch the Succubus’s head, chest, or waist to connect automatically. The connection will be released when you move away, but since the Slime remains in Connection Body form, you can reconnect easily just by touching again. (You can check whether you’re connected by looking at the white sphere in front of the body.)[/p][/*][*][p]While connected, if you touch another Succubus, the Slime will connect to her as well. This allows you to stimulate multiple Succubi at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]To stop automatic connections, repeat the same key input to return the Slime to its normal body.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3]Crystal generation, which was often mis-triggered with rotation, now requires a key hold to activate.[/h3][p]An effect will appear while charging. If you don’t want to generate, perform another key input at this point to cancel the generation.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Other Improvements[/h3][p]Manual updated.[/p][p]New sound effects added.[/p][p]Minor adjustments and balancing.[/p][hr][/hr][p]These improvements are also available in the Demo version—enjoy![/p]

notes.title: Feedback & Bug Report Board Established
notes.content: [p]We’ve set up a board for feedback and bug reports.[/p][p]If you have any requests or ideas such as “I wish the game could do this,” please feel free to share them with us. Questions are also always welcome![/p]

notes.title: Manual Supplement
notes.content: [h3]Slime Body Movement[/h3][p]- Horizontal movement works the same as in most games: use the Arrow keys or W/A/S/D to move forward, backward, left, and right.  [/p][p]- For vertical movement, hold the sub key (Right Click) and use the Up/Down Arrow or W/S.  [/p][p]- For rotation, hold the sub key (Right Click) and also hold the main key (Left Click), then use the Arrow keys or W/A/S/D.  [/p][p][i]Tip: Separating these three controls makes movement easier.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Grab Operations Using Rays from the Handle[/h3][p]- First, move the position of the handle with the mouse or controller and aim the ray at the succubus or another object. (The ray color changes depending on the type of object that can be interacted with.)  [/p][p]- Press the main key (Left Click) briefly to display the menu of that object.  [/p][p]- Press and hold the main key (Left Click) to grab the object, and continue grabbing it until you release the key.  [/p][p]- While grabbing, use the Up/Down Arrow or W/S to adjust the ray length and pull the object closer or push it farther away.  [/p][p][i]Tip: By using depth adjustment and rotation, you can grab and move objects to any position in space.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Stimulation with Grab Actions[/h3][p]- If you keep grabbing the succubus's face, chest, or waist, the Slime Body will change into a Stimulation Slime. When the change happens, an effect will appear. If you do not want it to change, release the grab. [/p][p]- While grabbing as a Stimulation Slime, press the Select key (Space key) to switch to a Continuous Stimulation Slime, which continues moving even after you release the grab.  [/p][p][i]Tip: Understand the flow as Normal Grab → Stimulation Grab → Continuous Stimulation Slime.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Aerial Fixation with Grab Actions[/h3][p]- While grabbing the succubus’s arm or leg, press the Select key (Space key) to attach a Fixation Slime to the arm or leg.  [/p][p]- With a Fixation Slime attached, grabbing and moving an arm or leg will change the position of that slime. If you grab and move the body instead, all Fixation Slimes will move simultaneously.  [/p][p]- While a Fixation Slime is attached, press the Select key (Space key) again while grabbing to remove it.  [/p][p][i]Tip: By adjusting the position of the Fixation Slimes, or by choosing to attach them to only the arms, only the legs, or both, you can pose the succubus as you like and stimulate her.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Connecting the Slime Body to the Succubus[/h3][p]- When you move the white sphere in front of the Slime Body close to the succubus’s face, chest, or waist, the color will change.  [/p][p]- While the color is changed, press the sub key (Right Click), hold the main key (Left Click), and then press the Select key (Space key) to transform the Slime Body and connect it to the succubus.  [/p][p]- Once connected, the succubus will be stimulated automatically if the Slime Body remains close to the connected area.  [/p][p]- If you move far away from the connected area while connected, the connection will be released automatically.  [/p][p][i]Tip: Since connecting the Slime Body is a large action, remember it as pressing all the keys together.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][h3]One-Handed Operation[/h3][p]- When using a mouse, you can assign the arrow keys and the Space key to a multi-button mouse to operate with one hand. VR controllers can originally be operated with only one.  [/p][p][i]Tip: This way, your other hand can be used for something else!!! [/i]ːcozybethesdaː[/p][hr][/hr][p]That’s all. Thank you for your continued support![/p]
